mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT_MEMBER A, PAYMENT_FAMILY_MEMBER B WHERE A.delete_yn = 'N' AND B.family_delete_yn = 'N' AND A.pay_family_member_idx = B.pay_family_member_idx AND A.pay_member_idx = #{pay_member_idx}

SELECT homepage_id, pay_family_member_idx, family_idx, family_name, family_phone, family_tel, TO_CHAR(family_birth,'yyyy-MM-dd') AS family_birth, family_sex, family_email_address, family_etc, family_add_id, family_add_date, family_add_ip, family_modify_id, family_modify_date, family_delete_id, family_delete_date, family_delete_ip, family_delete_yn, SUBSTR(family_phone, 1, INSTR(family_phone, '-', 1, 1) - 1) AS family_phone1, SUBSTR(family_phone, INSTR(family_phone, '-', 1, 1) + 1, INSTR(family_phone, '-', 1, 2) - INSTR(family_phone, '-', 1, 1) - 1) AS family_phone2, SUBSTR(family_phone, INSTR(family_phone, '-', 1, 2) + 1) AS family_phone3 FROM PAYMENT_FAMILY_MEMBER WHERE family_delete_yn = 'N' AND pay_family_member_idx = #{pay_family_member_idx} ORDER BY family_idx

SELECT homepage_id, pay_member_idx, pay_family_member_idx, pay_member_name, phone,tel,loan_number, birth, join_start_date, join_end_date, use_type, sex, sponsorship_amount, approve_yn, add_id, add_date, add_ip, modify_id, modify_date, delete_id, delete_date, delete_ip, delete_yn, etc, family_yn, REGEXP_SUBSTR (email_address, '[^@]+', 1, 1) AS email1, REGEXP_SUBSTR (email_address, '[^@]+', 1, 2) AS email2, family_count FROM PAYMENT_MEMBER WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND pay_member_idx = #{pay_member_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT_MEMBER ( homepage_id, pay_member_idx, pay_family_member_idx, pay_member_name, phone, tel, loan_number, birth, join_start_date, join_end_date, use_type, sex, sponsorship_amount, approve_yn, add_id, add_date, add_ip, modify_id, modify_date, delete_id, delete_date, delete_ip, delete_yn, etc, email_address, family_yn, family_count ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{pay_member_idx}, #{pay_member_idx}, #{pay_member_name}, #{phone}, #{tel}, #{loan_number}, #{birth}, #{join_start_date}, #{join_end_date}, #{use_type}, #{sex}, #{sponsorship_amount}, 'Y', #{add_id}, SYSDATE, #{add_ip}, #{modify_id}, #{modify_date}, #{delete_id}, #{delete_date}, #{delete_ip}, 'N', #{etc}, #{email_address}, #{family_yn}, #{family_count} )
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENT_MEMBER SET pay_member_name = #{pay_member_name}, phone = #{phone}, tel = #{tel}, loan_number = #{loan_number}, join_start_date = #{join_start_date}, join_end_date = #{join_end_date}, use_type = #{use_type}, sponsorship_amount = #{sponsorship_amount}, modify_id = #{modify_id}, modify_date = SYSDATE, email_address = #{email_address}, etc = #{etc} WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND pay_member_idx = #{pay_member_idx}

UPDATE PAYMENT_FAMILY_MEMBER SET family_name = #{family_name}, family_phone = #{family_phone}, family_tel = #{family_tel}, family_birth = #{family_birth}, family_sex = #{family_sex}, family_email_address = #{family_email_address}, family_etc = #{family_etc}, family_modify_date = SYSDATE WHERE family_delete_yn = 'N' AND pay_family_member_idx = #{pay_family_member_idx}
UPDATE PAYMENT_MEMBER SET delete_id = #{delete_id}, delete_ip = #{delete_ip}, delete_yn = 'Y', delete_date = SYSDATE WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND pay_member_idx = #{pay_member_idx}
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX(family_idx), 0) + 1 FROM PAYMENT_FAMILY_MEMBER WHERE pay_family_member_idx = #{pay_family_member_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT_FAMILY_MEMBER ( homepage_id, pay_family_member_idx, family_idx, family_name, family_phone, family_tel, family_birth, family_sex, family_email_address, family_etc, family_add_id, family_add_date, family_add_ip, family_modify_id, family_modify_date, family_delete_id, family_delete_date, family_delete_ip, family_delete_yn ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{pay_family_member_idx}, #{family_idx}, #{family_name}, #{family_phone}, #{family_tel}, #{family_birth}, #{family_sex}, #{family_email_address}, #{family_etc}, #{family_add_id}, SYSDATE, #{family_add_ip}, #{family_modify_id}, #{family_modify_date}, #{family_delete_id}, #{family_delete_date}, #{family_delete_ip}, 'N' )
